title: Lab Safety Institute
description: Documented public safety training body (Lab Safety Institute (nonprofit)) for the Lab Safety Verifier capability area.
body:
Lab Safety Institute is a documented safety training body from Lab Safety Institute (nonprofit). Nonprofit providing lab safety training, audits, and the widely used safety guidelines for academic and industrial labs.

How it works: It works by testing every design parameter against its allowed min/max limits and reporting pass or fail per parameter.

Documented uses of this capability area include warehouse automation fleets, surgical robotics, autonomous laboratories, drone delivery networks, and subsea exploration.
